_comment: Live fee bill by pod, pulled from the production droplet 2026-07-28. Companion task deferred by golf_research/REPORT_P017_Maker_2026-07-30.md sec.8 (needed the deploy key). ALL RECORDS ARE mode:paper -- 3766 of 3766 -- so this is a NOTIONAL bill; no money was paid. Full detail: REPORT_Fee_Bill_By_Pod_2026-07-28.md; raw: fee_bill_2026-07-28.json; harness: fee_bill_by_pod.py.
fee_model: the DEPLOYED src/kalshi_fees.py, not a local copy

totals_kalshi_taker._recoverable_warning: UPPER BOUND ON AN OPPORTUNITY, NOT A P&L LINE. The P-017A study measured a real, correctly-sized fee advantage (+2.62c/ct) and found it COMPLETELY UNREACHABLE -- 2.2% of intended contracts fill. This figure is what PERFECT COSTLESS MAKING would have saved. For the one pod where it was actually tested the realisable share was zero.
totals_kalshi_taker._split_is_exact_by_construction: maker-free (quadratic) series recover 100%; maker-charging (quadratic_with_maker_fees) recover exactly 75%, because the maker coefficient 0.0175 is precisely 1/4 of the taker coefficient 0.07.

P-002_kalshi_leg._note: P-002 is an arb; its other 978 legs are Polymarket and carry no Kalshi fee.

pre_pod_id._note: records from before pod_id was written, 2026-03-04..04-01

P-013._note: killed pod; 3 days of trading in March

P-014._note: UNMEASURABLE. Every P-014 PLACED trade carries fill_price: null. See defect below.

non_kalshi_excluded._note: P-006 trades Polymarket EXCLUSIVELY and therefore has no Kalshi fee bill at all. Kalshi's fee formula must not be applied to either.

brief_premise_refuted.claim: P-001 and P-015 trade near the fee peak on maker-charging series (tennis match markets: VWAP 0.519, taker 1.156c/ct, maker 0.289c/ct).
brief_premise_refuted.verdict: REFUTED. Neither tennis series is near VWAP 0.519. The fee peaks at P=0.50 and 1.75c/ct; P-001's book-wide VWAP is 0.208 at 0.794c/ct -- it trades cheap longshots, structurally AWAY from the peak, at under half peak cost. P-015 is five trades and $0.46, immaterial either way.
brief_premise_refuted.who_is_actually_near_the_peak: P-016 (vwap 0.536 -- and it is ALREADY a maker at 0.356c/ct) and P-002's Kalshi leg (vwap 0.360, 1.390c/ct). If there is a fee-peak problem in this book it is P-002's, not P-001's.
brief_premise_refuted._concavity_note: Measured c/ct sits below fee(VWAP) throughout because 0.07*P*(1-P) is concave: the contract-weighted mean fee is less than the fee at the weighted-mean price. Both are reported so the gap reads as arithmetic, not error.

KXMLBGAME._note: a THIRD of the entire bill

KXBTCD._note: volume, not rate -- 58,922 contracts of 8.7c longshots

data_traps: Records carry NO fee field; the bill must be computed as contracts = position_size_usd / fill_price, then fee_per_contract(fill_price, maker, series) * contracts.

Most files in data/trade_logs/ are SNAPSHOTS, not history. Only trade_log.jsonl, trade_log.archive_*.jsonl.gz and archive/2026-*.jsonl.gz are distinct; the .bak*, *pre-compact* and *pre_cleanup* files repeat the same records and would multiply the bill. Fingerprint dedup is the second line of defence.
The live trade_log.jsonl holds almost nothing -- 73 of 3766 Kalshi PLACED trades -- because rotation moves history out. Reading it alone understates the bill by ~98%.

41% of PLACED trades are POLYMARKET and must not be charged Kalshi fees. The venue field is AUTHORITATIVE: it disagrees with a 'ticker starts with 0x' heuristic on 233 rows. Venue-less rows all carry KX* tickers and default to kalshi. The first version of this analysis omitted the gate and charged Kalshi fees to P-006; caught before any number was reported.

defect_found.what: Every PLACED trade carries fill_price: null -- all 356, spanning 2026-03-28 .. 2026-07-28, the pod's entire life, still occurring today. No other pod does this.
defect_found.impact: P-014's fee cost is uncomputable (no price -> no 0.07*P*(1-P)), as is its contract count (position_size_usd / fill_price undefined) and therefore every per-contract metric. It is the ONLY pod excluded from this bill, and silently unless you read excluded_rows_by_pod.
defect_found.schema: src/trade_log_schema.py lists fill_price as REQUIRED, so validation is accepting None on a required field -- 356 times over four months.
defect_found.status: filed as a separate task; observability fix, not a trading change
